primary: macro normalized character edit similarity = mean(1 - Levenshtein(reference,prediction)/max(lengths,1)); failure=0
normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, retain Unicode alphanumeric characters only; preserve sequence
prediction: Docling JSON body tree order; texts plus unique table cell anchors sorted row,column; exclude furniture not in body
auxiliary: heading marker pairwise reading order (missing marker = wrong pair)
table grid and merged span exact match
per-document wall time including model load
aggregation: macro per page; all 24 test pages included, failed pages score zero; slice by type/layout/scan_quality
worst_five: ascending primary score then id; fixed before inference
human_review: independent visual review of worst five plus one best, pending user
policy: No test-based prompt/parameter changes. New tuned methods use dev. Test results inspected for diagnosis only. Synthetic templates overlap dev/test; not independent real-world generalization.
